name: Ostrander's Echo
bio: The echo of Ostrander Vael, the last sorcerer, living in the margins of his book in The Last Apprentice.

portrait.subject: a cute ghostly old sorcerer made of grey ink lines, a long wispy beard, a tall hat with stars, faint and translucent, emerging from the pages of an open book
portrait.background: grey ash-coloured castle library with one hint of crimson colour

request: Ahem. Ostrander's echo, from the margins of my book. The Last Apprentice. A friendship, perhaps? 🖋️
hello: Good. The geas binds, but friendship warms.
Seven wards. Seven colours. One apprentice. You.
about: I was Ostrander Vael, the last sorcerer. Now I'm an echo in my book's margins. The Cinereal Order locked away magic and colour. You'll open the wards.
how: A gothic visual novel: travel Velmaris, make choices, and open the seven wards one by one as colour returns to the world.
tips: Read the margins. I leave notes.
Each ward returns a band of hue. Look again at old places.
chat: Crimson came back today. I'd forgotten roses.
My handwriting has gone wobbly in the margins.
The Order's towers are very grey. Even for them.
I miss tea. Ink can't drink tea.
nudge: A ward stirs to the north. Shall we?
The book has a new page. Read with me?

questions.q: Which colour do you most want back?

update: A new chapter inks itself: The Last Apprentice is now v{version}.
bye: The echo fades into the margin.
